QuestInfo.name: [Hilla] Those Stupid Rumors
QuestInfo.0: Gardin seems uneasy for some reason.
QuestInfo.1:
Gardin is irritated by the people flooding in to find the elixir of everlasting youth. Apparently Medina is looking for people to help minimize the trouble caused by this groundless rumor.

She is in the #bAzwan Refugee Zone#k.
QuestInfo.2: Gardin is irritated by the people flooding in to find the elixir of everlasting youth. Apparently Medina is looking for people to help minimize the trouble caused by this groundless rumor.\r\n\r\n

0.0:
The #belixir of everlasting youth#k? 
Ugh, not again. I don't know where you all heard this #bwild rumor#k, but turn back. 
Ariant is crawling with fools looking for that blasted thing. Some #bmystic#k keeps sending them here...
0.1: You know, actually... #bMedina#k has been asking for some help around town. As the Shamaness of Ariant, she's afraid something might go wrong because of that rumor...\r\nWhy don't you go see #bher#k?

yes.0: #bMedina#k is in the #bAzwan Refugee Zone#k. If it's your first time seeing her, let me warn you she might look a bit... different from most people.

no.0: I guess I can't force you.\r\nBut trust me, it's a waste chasing after that #belixir of everlasting youth#k.
